Description: Unique identifier for a recorded traffic accident event
Calendar year in which the collision occurred
Police reference number for the collision report
Easting coordinate in the Ordnance Survey National Grid (OSGB36) reference system
Northing coordinate in the Ordnance Survey National Grid (OSGB36) reference system
WGS84 geographic longitude of the collision location
WGS84 geographic latitude of the collision location
Lower Super Output Area (LSOA) code identifying the census geography of the collision
Calendar date on which the collision occurred (YYYY-MM-DD)
Day of the week on which the collision occurred (coded integer)
Time of day at which the collision occurred (HH:MM)
Severity classification of the collision: Fatal (1), Serious (2), or Slight (3)
Count of vehicles involved in the collision
Total number of casualties (killed or injured) resulting from the collision
Police force area responsible for recording and reporting the collision
Flag indicating whether a police officer attended the scene of the accident
Type of road on which the collision occurred (e.g. single carriageway, dual carriageway, roundabout)
Posted speed limit in miles per hour at the collision location
Classification of the first (primary) road at the collision site (e.g. Motorway, A road, B road)
Numeric identifier of the first road at the collision site
Classification of the second road at a junction collision site
Numeric identifier of the second road at a junction collision site
Flag indicating whether the road is classified as a trunk road
Classification of the collision location as urban or rural
Type of junction at or near the collision location
Historic coding of junction type (legacy field from pre-2016 STATS19 reporting)
Type of traffic control present at the junction (e.g. traffic signals, give way, stop sign)
Ambient light conditions at the time of the collision (e.g. daylight, darkness with lighting)
Weather conditions at the time and location of the collision
Condition of the road surface at the time of the collision (e.g. dry, wet, frost)
Any special conditions or hazards present at the collision site
Hazards present on the carriageway at the time of the collision
Historic coding of carriageway hazards (legacy field from pre-2016 STATS19 reporting)
Historic coding of human-controlled pedestrian crossing presence (legacy STATS19 field)
Historic coding of physical pedestrian crossing facilities (legacy STATS19 field)
Type of pedestrian crossing facility present at the collision location
Local authority district in which the collision occurred
ONS (Office for National Statistics) code for the local authority district
Highway authority responsible for the road where the collision occurred
Current highway authority code (updated from legacy coding)
Enhanced injury-based severity classification (where police forces have adopted injury-based reporting)
Flag indicating whether this record uses injury-based rather than outcome-based severity coding
Adjusted serious severity classification accounting for injury-based reporting adjustments
Adjusted slight severity classification accounting for injury-based reporting adjustments
